headline: AI workflow and inference stacks still lead—but relative growth swapped leaders.
summary: This week’s absolute 7-day gains still favor n8n, ComfyUI, and vLLM. On relative growth, though, langgraph and directus outpaced the board—signals you usually miss on a raw star leaderboard.

signals.label: This week
signals.text: n8n and ComfyUI each picked up nearly a thousand stars; workflow heat is not fading. vLLM follows steadily—inference-as-a-service looks like demand, not hype.

signals.label: Under-read signal
signals.text: langgraph led the site at 1.47% weekly relative growth, a hint that agent orchestration is splitting out from the langchain mainline. directus is a rare Backend-category acceleration.

signals.label: Next week’s prompt
signals.text: Worth a Discussions thread on relative growth vs absolute gains: when picking tools, do percentage jumps on smaller projects beat raw star deltas on giants?
